slice: Bounded anonymous PostgreSQL fixture image retry

observedFailure.head: 98a443f439558d0523fe2c79df8c9b9c89744c8b
observedFailure.event: Application downloaded postgres:17, then anonymous ECR pull reported toomanyrequests: Rate exceeded. Database prefetch succeeded. Whole workflow was still running when this record was prepared.

behavior: Three attempts per fixed image, with5s then10s waits only for an allowlist of throttle/temporary transport failures. Unknown errors, permanent diagnostics, termination and tag failures stop immediately.
Every attempt uses the same owned anonymous Docker config and default daemon. No credentials, account, alternate registry, mutable image override or authenticated fallback. Cleanup runs on exit.
No workflow gate is bypassed and no failed run is relabeled passing. A later actual CI run must prove the download repair.

checks.independentReview: Root inspected the bounded retry loop and mocked failure/cleanup/context cases; no remaining finding.
checks.limit: Tests use docker/sleep shims; no local live image pull or claim that ECR cannot throttle again.

limits: Current database/browser/identity-restore and whole CI outcome are separate evidence.
All release and launch gates remain pending.
